recipe.visualDefinition: A medium close-up portrait of a man in a dark jacket against a bright, overexposed natural background, featuring a prominent circular typographic emblem on the right side.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject positioned off-center left to balance the large graphic element on the right.
Contrast between the dark, textured clothing and the high-key, blown-out background.
Circular frame containing text that overlaps the subject's shoulder slightly.
Cool-toned color grading with desaturated greens and blues.
coreInvariants: Circular graphic container for primary text.
Desaturated, matte finish on the overall image.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the left two-thirds of the frame, medium shot from waist up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The circular graphic emblem on the right acts as the primary focal anchor for information.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the subject's face, move down to the dark jacket, then right to the circular logo.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive blown-out white space in the upper right and background areas.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Desaturated dark teal/navy in the jacket and graphic lines.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Overexposed white and pale cream in the background.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Natural skin tones and muted green foliage.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value contrast between the subject and the background.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to cool teals, greys, and whites

letterConstructionRules: Uniform stroke weight for the top line.
Extremely condensed, tall verticality for the middle line.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Stacking contrasting widths of the same sans-serif family within a circular frame.
graphicDevices: Thick circular stroke framing the text
Horizontal divider lines implied by text spacing

candidateDirections.reason: For the wide, geometric top line.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A medium portrait of a man with short curly hair and light stubble, wearing a dark navy field jacket over a grey button-down shirt. The background is a bright, overexposed outdoor scene with hints of green trees and a lake, using a shallow depth of field. The lighting is soft and high-key.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large teal circular ring on the right side. Inside the ring, place three lines of uppercase sans-serif text: a wide bold font on top, an ultra-condensed tall font in the middle, and a small clean font at the bottom. The text should be centered within the circle.

verificationChecks: Is the text contained within a thick circular stroke?
Is the middle line of text significantly more condensed than the top line?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the artist
Exact wording of the album title
postGenerationChecks: Check that the circle does not obscure the subject's face.
Ensure the overexposure doesn't wash out the subject's skin tones.
Verify the typography is perfectly centered within the circle.
Confirm the color palette remains desaturated and cool-toned.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-key, shallow-depth portrait with a geometric circular typographic emblem using contrasting sans-serif widths.
